title: Split-Beat Monitor
constraints: Write `class beat_monitor` with `function new(virtual beat_if vif)`, `task run()` (forever, sampling on `posedge vif.clk`), and public `msg msgs[$]` and `int n_withdrawn`.

A beat transfers on a rising edge with `valid && ready`. Collect transferred bytes into the current message, and when a transferred beat has `last = 1`, push the message (a **new** `msg` object each time) to `msgs`. Messages are 1 to 8 beats long.

Protocol check: once `valid` is high while `ready` is low, the source must keep `valid` high until the transfer. Count every edge where `valid` is found low right after such a stalled edge in `n_withdrawn`.
hints: Remember `pending = valid && !ready` from the previous edge. That's all the protocol check needs.
Beats seen with `valid = 1` but `ready = 0` are not transferred and must not be collected.
Allocate the next `msg` right after publishing the current one, since subscribers keep the handle.

examples.title: protocol
examples.input: the source drops valid while stalled
